rounds.rule: A row gets ok only from a current listing, its own site or recent reviews with nothing saying closed (docs/EATS.md). A row is taken out when a search could not find the place at all or the sources disagree; a place found but not freshly confirmed stays without ok.
rounds.scope: the 2 rows without ok; the rows already confirmed were not checked again
rounds.how: Google Maps opened in headless Chromium (2026-11-23), limited view without a reviews tab, so no review date could be read; a place with current hours and no closed notice counts as a current listing
